card.name: Plural nouns after a drug or group
card.fires_on: The plural noun 'patients' (or 'ones'/'one') right after a drug or condition name, as in 'letrozole patients' or 'diabetic patients'. Also the 'IENT' piece inside 'PATIENTS' in warnings.
